messages.author: 9d9b55ee48f897d2
messages.subject: Strategy=3
parts:
Dear Vincent,

I have a question related to strategy=3 (use the x most active days). In my study protocol, Actigraphs are sent by mail to the participants. They wear the device for 8 days, but I always have some time before and after this week when the device is measuring but not worn (sometimes until a week before and a week after). I was planning to use strategy = 3 , but when I check the 'plots to check data quality', I can see that GGIR does not select the 7 most active days (see screenshot below). It selects 7 non-active days, sets them as non-wear and I end up with no valid days. Is there a reason why GGIR is doing this (and, hopefully, a solution)?

Kind regards,
Nina

These are the cleaning parameters in my script:

includedaycrit = 16,              
     ndayswindow = 7,               
     strategy = 3,
includedaycrit.part5 = 0.667,
do.imp = TRUE,                    
     minimum_MM_length.part5 = 23,     
     #excludefirstlast = FALSE,      
     includenightcrit = 16,            
     excludefirst.part4 = FALSE,       
     excludelast.part4 = FALSE,

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Strategy=3
parts:
Hi Nina,

Just leaving a note that we discussed this last week and discovered that it is a bug in the strategy=3 setting and we are working on a solution.

Best, Vincent
